character: A Catskills resort in the village of Hunter, operated by Vail Resorts. It is one of the larger ski areas within a few hours' drive of New York City, so weekends can be busy.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the base. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 21, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). Vail Resorts released its 2026/27 opening dates on Aug 18, 2026, but the search summary did not show Hunter's date — check the release (More links). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

prices.note: Aggregator listing via search summary ("weekday $97 child to $128 adult"); season not stated. Hunter sells date-based tickets online. Confirm at source.
Aggregator listing via search summary ("weekend $136 child to $179 adult"); season not stated. Confirm at source.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79 to Binghamton, I-88 E to Exit 21 (Harpersfield), NY-23 E via Stamford and Grand Gorge to Prattsville, then NY-23A E to Hunter); not a routing-service result. Two-lane mountain roads for the last ~70 km; winter conditions add time.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY Thruway (I-87) S to Exit 21 (Catskill), then NY-23/NY-23A W through Kaaterskill Clove to Hunter); not a routing-service result.
